visualRisks: Actual native result is 887x1774, below requested 1536x3072; do not claim native4K.
High-overhead side-view monitors offer very narrow screen planes: overlays should be restrained color/status flicker only, no readable dashboard UI.
Keyboard space bars are not strongly distinguished and keycaps are stylized; no legible text was generated.
Furniture-only contact coordinates are suggested source-space anchors; exact existing character/chair alignment and occlusion require runtime compositor verification.
At alpha >=1 the original has faint stray fringe outside furniture; alpha >=16 occupied bounds are tighter. Source remains unmodified.
LED accents are faint and fourth pair differs slightly in vertical position; use per-seat anchors, not one replicated offset.
